name: Chou'un Shiryuu
source:
She joins [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] after the battle with [url=/c237]Enshou[/url]. She has a strong obsession of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Menma]menma[/url] of all kinds. She also has a habit of running around the city as the masked hero of justice, "Butterfly Mask" in her patrol shift.
